user.title: 4HEAT Lite Stove
user.description: Enter the details from your 4HEAT WiFi module label. Cloud sync requires a DNS override and firewall DNAT on your router. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/pafernanr/homeassistant-4heatlite#proxy-setup) for instructions.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to module. Verify IP and that stove is powered on.

init.description: Cloud sync requires a DNS override and firewall DNAT on your router to redirect the 4HEAT module traffic to Home Assistant. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/pafernanr/homeassistant-4heatlite#proxy-setup) for instructions.
